title: Signing in Blood
summary: A Book of Shadows does not belong to a witch until the witch gives it a name written in their own blood.
pages: Blood is not merely an ingredient. It is identity made physical. A true Book of Shadows must know whose memories it is meant to keep.
Sign the book with your own blood. From that moment, its true writing belongs to you alone. Other hands may touch the cover, but the knowledge within is yours.
